title: Four Function Calculator
title_vi: Thử Thách: Máy Tính 4 Phép Toán
overview: Write a modular calculator script with add, sub, mul, and div functions.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice the reviewed shell concepts below. Instructions are independently written; functional requirements follow the linked public lesson.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành các khái niệm shell bên dưới. Hướng dẫn được biên soạn lại; yêu cầu chức năng theo bài công khai được liên kết.

sections.title: Create Calculator Functions
sections.content:
Complete add, subtract, multiply and divide in calculator.sh. Read two integers and a quoted operator from stdin; reject division by zero.

`10,5,+` → `Result: 15`; `10,5,-` → `Result: 5`; `10,5,*` → `Result: 50`; `10,5,/` → `Result: 2`; `10,0,/` → `Error: Division by zero is not allowed.`
sections.content_vi:
Hoàn thiện add, subtract, multiply và divide trong calculator.sh. Đọc hai số nguyên và toán tử từ stdin; xử lý chia cho 0.

`10,5,+` → `Result: 15`; `10,5,-` → `Result: 5`; `10,5,*` → `Result: 50`; `10,5,/` → `Result: 2`; `10,0,/` → `Error: Division by zero is not allowed.`

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/calculator.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['add', 'subtract', 'multiply', 'divide', 'read']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in []),result.stdout
    for a,b,op,expected in [(10,5,'+','Result: 15'),(10,5,'-','Result: 5'),(10,5,'*','Result: 50'),(10,5,'/','Result: 2'),(10,0,'/','Error: Division by zero is not allowed.'),(23,7,'+','Result: 30'),(9,3,'*','Result: 27')]:
        assert expected in execute([str(p)], f'{a}\n{b}\n{op}\n').stdout
    for function,a,b,expected in [('add',23,7,'30'),('subtract',23,7,'16'),('multiply',9,3,'27'),('divide',27,3,'9'),('divide',10,0,'Error: Division by zero is not allowed.')]:
        outcome=execute(['-c','source \"$1\" </dev/null >/dev/null; \"$2\" \"$3\" \"$4\"','bash',str(p),function,str(a),str(b)])
        assert expected in outcome.stdout, outcome.stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Review your scripts and retry their edge cases. Passing these local checks does not certify source-private grader parity.
sections.content_vi: Ôn lại script và thử trường hợp biên. Đạt bộ kiểm tra local không có nghĩa đã phục hồi bộ chấm riêng của nguồn.
